slides.text: Demonstration only — requires qualified safety/content-owner review before training use. On this illustrative machine-guarding card, select the two items that describe guarding controls. This is not an operating, servicing or lockout procedure.

slides.correctFeedback: You selected both illustrative guarding controls and no distractors. Have the activity reviewed against the actual equipment and local requirements before training use.
